## Notes and gaps

* JBIG-KIT: its COPYING file is the GNU GPL version 2 text; the file added here (`jbigkit-COPYING.txt`) came from a GitHub mirror (ImageMagick/jbig) because the author's own site did not serve it at the address tried. Its public header names the author, Markus Kuhn.
* Saxon-HE: its licence file could not be found at the addresses tried; the MPL-2.0 text above covers it.
* Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs: not in the package (Microsoft limits who may pass them on); the user installs Microsoft's own copy. See `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`, "Still to do", item 2.
* The Apache License 2.0 is the repository's own `LICENSE`.
